title: Minimal Hand Spec (AI → Lesson Pipeline)
description: Small semantic hand description for lesson-builder. Pipeline produces snapshots and step-config. Blinds and full seating (playersInfo + heroSeat) required for legal preflop; actorSeat for stable action order.

specVersion.description: Spec format version; builder rejects incompatible versions.

description.description: Optional narrative or intro text for the lesson.

blinds.description: Builder must enforce bb > 0, sb > 0, sb < bb.

stacksBB.description: Optional per-position or per-seat stack overrides in BB. Fallback: startingStacksBB for all.

board.description: Full runout (max 5 unique cards); pipeline reveals cards when street occurs.

actions.description: At least one action; max 40 to prevent runaway generation.

items.description: Only one of sizeBB or sizePot may be set per action. Builder enforces ordering by street and legal seat order within street; at least one action must have actorSeat === heroSeat.

street.description: Only these four streets; no POSTFLOP or TURN_RIVER.

sizeBB.description: Bet size in big blinds (e.g. 2.5). Mutually exclusive with sizePot.

sizePot.description: Fraction of current pot (e.g. 0.75 = 75% pot; 1.5 = 150% overbet). Builder converts to BB. Mutually exclusive with sizeBB.

isHeroDecision.description: Optional explicit marker; if absent, infer from actorSeat === heroSeat.

beforeInstructorMessage.description: Optional prompt shown before this hero decision (e.g. 'Decision 2. Facing a turn bet…').

followUpContent.description: Optional teaching note shown after the decision; replaces '(Add teaching note.)' placeholder.

constraints.description: Optional validation hints for teaching intent. Builder runs these after building snapshots; if any fail, reject spec. Not required to reconstruct the hand.

minStreetReached.description: Hand must reach at least this street.

minHeroDecisions.description: At least this many hero decision points.

villainBarrels.description: Villain (non-hero) must bet on at least this many streets.

tags.description: Optional tags for lesson organization (e.g. float, turn-barrel). Not used by pipeline logic.
